User is compiling a supply order for the Selbury depot.
Key items to add:
- Line item 415: Cable reels.
- Line item 95: Ladders.
- Line item: 150 tarps.
- Deduct 70 from returned stock.
- Flat delivery fee: 55.

- Lifts: Slow near library annex, garden studio, east wing, loading bay, north office, harbour room, and print room.

- Facilities: Coffee machines operational in garden studio, north office, harbour room, print room, east wing, library annex.
